sn35.245:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:1.2: “kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī”ti?
sn35.245:1.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:2.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:2.2: “kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī”ti?
sn35.245:2.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:3.2: “kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī”ti?
sn35.245:3.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:4.2: “kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī”ti?
sn35.245:4.3: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbantaṃ nirodhadhammanti” yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:5.1: atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhuno pañhavyākaraṇena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: idhāhaṃ bhante yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:5.2: “kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī”ti?
sn35.245:5.3: evaṃ vutte bhante so bhikkhu maṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:5.4: yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:5.5: atha khvāhaṃ bhante, asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:5.6: “kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī”ti?
sn35.245:5.7: evaṃ vutte bhante so bhikkhu maṃ etadavoca:
sn35.245:5.8: yato ca kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe…
sn35.245:5.9: catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe…
sn35.245:5.10: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbantaṃ nirodhadhammanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti.
sn35.245:5.11: atha khvāhaṃ bhante, asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhuno pañhavyākaraṇena yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
sn35.245:5.12: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti?
sn35.245:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhu purisassa kiṃsuko adiṭṭhapubbo assa.
sn35.245:6.2: so yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn35.245:6.5: “kāḷako kho ambho purisa, kiṃsuko, seyyathāpi jhāmakhāṇūti?
sn35.245:6.6: tena kho pana bhikkhu, samayena tādiso vassa kiṃsuko yathā tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.1: atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn35.245:7.5: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādiso vassa kiṃsuko yathā tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.6: atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn35.245:7.9: ocīrakajāto kho ambho purisa, kiṃsuko ādinnasipāṭiko, seyyathāpi sirīsoti.
sn35.245:7.10: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādisovassa kiṃsuko yathā tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.11: atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ purisaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn35.245:7.14: bahalapattapalāso kho ambho purisa, kiṃsuko sandacchāyo seyyathāpi nigrodhoti.
sn35.245:7.15: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādisovassa kiṃsuko yathā tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.
sn35.245:7.16: evameva kho bhikkhu yathā yathā adhimuttānaṃ tesaṃ sappurisānaṃ dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ, tathā tathā tehi tehi sappurisehi byākataṃ.
sn35.245:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhu rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷhuddāpaṃ daḷha pākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ.
sn35.245:8.2: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
sn35.245:8.3: puratthimāya disāya āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn35.245:8.7: atha kho taṃ sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarasāmissa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ niyyātetvā yathāgatamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
sn35.245:8.10: dakkhiṇāya disāya āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
sn35.245:8.14: atha kho taṃ sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarasāmissa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ nīyyātetvā yathāgatamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
sn35.245:9.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ bhikkhu katā atthassa viññāpanāya.
sn35.245:9.3: nagaranti kho bhikkhu imassetaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ. mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādana parimaddana
sn35.245:9.4: bhedana viddhaṃsana dhammassa. chadvāranti kho bhikkhu, channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.5: dovārikoti kho bhikkhu satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.6: sīghaṃ dūtayuganti kho bhikkhu samathavipassanānetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.245:9.8: majjhe siṅghāṭakoti kho bhikkhu catunnetaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ:
sn35.245:9.11: yathāgatamaggoti kho bhikkhu ariyassetaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ seyyathidaṃ:
